verdict.rationale: The docs show a contacts API endpoint (POST /contacts/create), an OpenAPI spec, and general 'manage contacts' capability through the API, CLI, and MCP. Segments are described as updating when properties change, which implies contact properties exist. There is no explicit evidence of update or suppress/unsubscribe endpoints, of how custom properties are defined, or of rate limits and bulk throughput for production scale. Missing for 10: documented contact update and suppression endpoints, explicit custom-property handling, rate-limit/bulk-scale documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.
